name: NewVision Security
old_description: In search of robust security solutions tailored to your business needs? You’ve come to the right place. With three decades of experience, NewVision Security has earned a reputation as the go-to choice for businesses seeking reliable protection. Our dedication to personalized service sets us apart – no distant corporate representatives here, just prompt and dependable support from our specialized teams.
about:
Founded in 1996 in Bismarck, North Dakota, NewVision Security grew from a local security installer into a regional provider of integrated life-safety and security systems. The company is led by President and CEO Cameron Fleck, who began working in the industry as a teenager, and Chief Strategy Officer Chris Utter, a veteran of multiple security ventures. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

NewVision designs, installs, services, and monitors security systems for commercial, residential, and institutional clients. Its core offerings include access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, and fire alarm systems. The company maintains a local service department staffed by factory-certified technicians and operates a 24/7 monitoring center. No facility size or headcount figures are published.

The client base spans small businesses, multi-site school districts, and private residences across the Dakotas and the broader Midwest. References include a multi-site school district installation and residential projects ranging from single-family homes to larger properties.

NewVision differentiates itself with a one-year warranty on parts and labor—double the industry’s typical 90-day coverage—and emphasizes direct, local support rather than distant corporate representatives. Membership in the Electronic Security Association and recognition on the 2026 SDM Top 100 list underscore its industry standing.
